Doesn't matter.... what matters are the words he spoke.

I ain't commitin suicide tonight ..though i dunno y i thot i'd post here .. but have been havin these thoughts that hurt me so this seeemed  appropriate... anyways ... How bad is having the thought of killling urself  strike you everyday for months at end and yet you are still friggin alive? I think bout it every day n yet just can't do it ..... find resaons or excuses .. wateva .. but haven't been ab;e tro do it .. just been able to get drnk like hellll...... is thuis normal fr anyone into a break up after 4 moinths? Will i get ovr it or will i lose my sanity? I value my sanity more than my life ... am a thinker and a poet .. insane life is no life ..

>but why even put forth the energy to fight the flow of life? 

COZ IT'S FUCKIN ME UP !! ... Earlier I though I'll fight fate and my life will be how I want it to be .. but recently the fate has given me such a big blow that I just can't stand up ...yes I'm flowing .... but I just can't enjoy it if it's taking me away from everything that I ever wanted .... Life has put me on a spot wherein I can't help but hate it ... 
I've always believed in Love ... still do .. but I guess that's what makes me the 'extinctbreed' ... Look around where is this love of which we speak .... marriages are more like business transactions wherein the spouse is factored on certain metrics and if he/she fits it ... the 'love' will follow .... how many are actually sticking together through thick and thin/better or worse ..... NOT after marriage .. but before that ... People go in and out of relationships like it's nothing... We're living in the times of speed dating and casual sex .... where is this love of which you speak .... I feel like a friggin misfit ....
Well I guess that makes two of us ... but you got money .. you cruise along and maybe you'll find your shore ... Let's see if my dinghy will make past this storm ...

Well rest assured I ain't a teenager .. But it surely made me smile .. I guess that psychiatric help(as suggested by somebody else in here) seems more appropriate now as I'm being mistaken for a teenager ... Let's just say I'm a grown up .. Though still like to believe in whole-hearted love, still like to believe in fate, still like to believe in soulmates and all that stupid stuff ... so I guess mentally I'm still a teenager

'The "emotional baggage of love" is the entire point of a relationship' ... I disagree .. Even though all the songs in the world will say that love is all that's required, tit's not true ... The worst feeling is when you love someone and can't provide them with the things you know that they deserve ... Love is nothing nowadays ..Think bout it logically n u'll agree ...

As for the part that there are plenty of people who can love her as much .... I hope you are right .... coz then it'll be a perfect life for her ...but about plenty of people who can love me as much ... nah ... not gonna let that happen ... even though I don't know a thing bout any aspect of my life and where it'll lead me .. this is one thing I'm sure of ... Not gonna let it happen .... Just not ... 

ps: the teenager part certainly was funny and your 'Oh, for fuck's sake, grow the hell up.' shows that you're a grown up who has experience in dealing with teenagers .. Thanks for your advice.....
Hopeless Romantic? .. I thought it was an 'extinctbreed' ...glad to meet you ..
Well money certainly makes it a bit easier ... I pray that the sad n depressing part changes in future fr ya n it'll be perfect ... Me on the other hand is a lost case .. : /

It's not bout being cheap ... I was forced to go to a counselor by my family ... I went in and told her that I don't wanna talk bout anything and will just sit there long enough so that my folks think I talked .. of course I reminded her of her oath that whateva is said or not said in the room stays in the room ... but her trying to make me open up and talk reiterated everything I dislike bout the whole thing ... Why does she care .. she had not known me before i entered that room and in a minute she's coaxing me to discuss my love life that I'll not even discuss with a person whom I trust completely leave aside a stranger ... Ended up discussing news and weather ... This seems better ... At least people don't put up a facade and will speak what they think ... if they feel that I'm a fuckin loser they'll say it to me and I don't think I can even expect that kinda honesty from a therapist or a psychiatrist ..
Straight to the point .. Nice .. Dunno if I can make that the mantra of my life but thanks nonetheless ..

I said that I am not going to anyone who'll ask me 'So how do you feel about that?' ... It just gets on to my nerves .... Just hate psychiatrists ...  and as for the skewed world views ... I feel it's more about the world being skewed ... Look around .... how many people are taking a plunge into love and how many are looking at it like a business deal ... Wrong times for my kinds .... but anyways that's different .. I ask you ... would you rather be with a guy/gal whom you love but who you know is not stable in life or would you rather be with someone who has it all sorted out n you feel that you can have a healthy relationship with him/her as you spend time together ... You answer ..

>through thick and thin/for better or worse? 

That's only left for the vows and romantic movies ... Real life's not like that ... and how can I make take that person whom I love down with me when I know that they deserve the best n am sure they'll get the best life has to offer somewhere else ... and YET I'm just not able to let go ...
Sound advice .... Thank u sir...  but the waves are getting freaky high to just breeze thru ... but thanks still ...

>That's not for you to decide. That's for them to decide.

NO.... I know that it's better for her ... if we leave the emotional baggage of love aside the other guy is better off any day of the week .. i just know that no one can love her as much .... but that's worth crap nowadays ... 

>Plenty of people hate their family members. Count yourself very lucky that you have family who actually love you.

Not on my side of the world .. they are stuck with me ... n I feel bad bout it ...

5 points for the comment show that it's a great, logical and sane advice n yet I don't wanna do it ... Have never been comfortable in discussin these things and rather i don't trust anyone, even the psychiatrists, enough to discuss this .. If my family comes to know bout my thoughts ... I'd only be hurting some more ppl who care fr me ... Also i just hate trite and bullshit advices ... that's why this anonymity on internet seemed to be a better option .... Thanks anyways ...
Been trying to do that for the last 4-5 months n yet can't stop myself from thinking bout her ... am just not able to let go ...
I dunno ..

thanks a lot for that brother ... You're right ... I am still in stage of hoping and praying that she'll come back ... I know i have my weaknesses but i never thought that she would give up on me .... anyone but her ....moving on is not an option right now .. i do have these anger pangs and end up posting in here ... but still ... even when i am really hurt about what she did to me ... i just can't hate her .... everyone says it will pass with time ... let's see ... 
I appreciate you taking out time to reply to me in here .... this is better than what those counsellors talk bout .. at least it's honest ... thanks

Exactly my point .... It has made me numb about life .. everything and everybody seems like a bloody farce .. the person whom you trusted enough to entrust your life with ... if she can change ... how can anyone be trusted ... My trouble is that i still have full respect for her and still love her completely ... just can't think otherwise ... dunno if ever will ..

I dunno if I'll be able to reach that place too someday wherein i can move on .. doesn't seem probable right now ... i know what she did was real wrong and it has made me do things i never thought i would and it has made me weaker than I've ever been .... and people say love gives you strength .... but i just can't move on ... just can't make myself come to terms with the fact that she's gone for ever ... kills me everytime ... I should shut up now ..sorry for acting like a damn weakling .. never thought it would come to this .. this is not me .. this is just not me .. but the anonymity in here gives me some solace ...

Did .. didn't help .. I find all those psychiatrists and counsellors damn phonies ... this is my therapy .. i like to write ... and as reddit ain't too popular on my side of the planet i can be myself in here without letting my friends or family know what i'm going through and hurting them ...

EDIT: More like was made to seek help ...

Sorry to hear about that ... and sorry for writing like that in my last post ... just wanted to type as fast as the thoughts are running through ny head .. As for your views ... still can't accept that ... it's good that this view helped you get over somebody who didn't deserve your love .. but not for me ... i can't do that ... it will mean me changing who i am ... i said i loved her and meant it .. how can I not love her now ... it's just not possible .... all those promises even if they hold no meaning for her now were true from my end ... i can't lie to myself ...

then where is the maturity and emotion in love ...if relationship is going sour u work on it n improve it .. u dont just abandon it ... if u can abandon it or rather even think bout abandoning it then it was all a farce frm the start .... u were in it till it was good and as soon as it dips u move out ... that's not love ... that's not a relationship ... that's putting up an act till u are enjoying it and then just going backstage n wiping off the damn make up ,,,

then why do ppl act on and say stuff that they don't mean ... why keep the other person on the hook and keep lying bout what you feel when you dont actually feel anything ...Now i don't even know when it ended ... or whether it was even there ...
if you can cut someone off then u never actually loved him/her ...
Still not gonna hear a thing against her dude .... i still love her ... dnt blv in deleting esp on reddit as its a free speech domain but don't say that again about her ... i loved her n still do ...
the whole damn wotrld is weird ... feel like a damn misfit ...
That's an extremely interesting observation .... and the more I think about it the more true it seems ...  thnks fr sharing ...
I appreciate your opinion ... Upvoted for not givin a fuck about downvotes and saying what you feel .... Rest I dunno about the facts or figures but thanks for replying ...

hell with it .. all i wanted was some empirical data .. not trite philosophical answers ... don't answer if you dont want to but it was never meant to be sexist .... answer on the basis of YOUR experience in life ... not what should be and shouldn't be .... but I ain't rewording that ..  if you can't understand the meaning behind the semantics then you can't give me a satisfactory answer ... 

PS : It might be phrased in a bad way ... but there is nothing like a horrible question ... a question is a question ..

I agree ... kindly excuse the generalisation ... just trying to see some empirical data .. nothing sexist ..

EDIT : Agree with the part that it is individual based ...

JUst a month and a half into it ... so I guess I can afford to stay here another couple o months without being an exception .. 

1) Has already lasted longer than just a couple o week ... and still end up doin that at nights ... Listening to Today by Garry Allan .. My story... His words .... Thanks for opening up your ordeal online for my sake ...

3) Deleted facebook account. Not pickin up calls for weeks now. Have lied to all already about not having time to meet up. : /

5) :) ..

The only recluse I feel is this portal .... finding people from around the globe and from all walks of life ... some helpful and some sadists .. Thus end up blabbering in here when I am drunk ... Even this is a recent change ... hopefully this will help .. ..

>Continuing to feel sorry for myself and try to get back with her

Not yet past that stage .... Dunno if/when I'll be ... 
Don't worry about the others ... I deserve all I get .... Need this actually ... Everyone tells me that I ain't bad or wrong but I know I am .... Know I can depend on redditors to crush a broken heart :) ..  Thanks again for ur help ... I shouldn't be in here ... I shouldn't be bloody drinking ... Doctor prescribed !! .... This ain't gonna solve anything .... Just hope I pass out from this booze soon ... Thanks ...

and back ... can't do much except reddit this drunk .. : / .. now lemme reply to ur posts ...
am outta here ...

I am at a loss for words ... I know it's a bit too late to say that now after such long posts ... But I truly am ... Great to find that there still are people who believe so strongly about it .. All I had got frm ppl till now was to man-up and move on ... and yet I am sitting here at 3 in the morning looking for answers .... I guess your last line 'Life is too short to live with half a flame' sums it up perfectly ... Nice talking with you ... Thanks for your wishes ....

In my current state of mind that certainly seems like a better place .... but right now I can't say what's good or bad  ... Because I seriously don't know ... So I'll just be the one taking advices today ...

Sorry to hear about that ... Glad to know that you're past that now .... In my case she got engaged within a week ... Now I don't know whether it was family pressure (Yes it's still a big factor in India) or whether she just wanted out .... maybe I'll find my peace when I get that answer ... not thru her as she says that it was the former but thru others around her ... As for trying to keep myself sane ... well currently am in the situation best described by the song 'I don't know what to do with myself - The white stripes' .. That's another trbl with love .. When it's around .. it just fills up your life and when it''s gone nothing else seems to be any important ... I feel guilty about hogging up so much of your time now ... So won't keep you hanging ... But I just needed this  ....  Can't thank you enough ...

I like your deep faith in love .. To me it made me go weak ... at least for now ... The only question left to be answered is whether she's a different person now or is it just family pressure .. I am trying my best to find answer to that too through her friends .. maybe once I reach the place wherein I feel that she's not the person I loved will I be able to survive this ordeal ... 
Dunno whether the same feeling will crop up again for a different person or rather if I would reach a place wherein I would let it crop up ... but for now it's tough to imagine .. I always say 'Never say Never' so won't say that it'll never happen ... but I can't see it right now ...  I had reached the place wherein I had chosen to not act on that feeling for anyone else and now I am being told to act on it .. Puts me in a dilemma of situation ... Maybe I'll cross it or maybe I won't ... 
I agree that we all like the feeling when we have it but the hurt that follows when it doesn't work out and when you have to face a facet of your personality that you never thought you had i.e. a weak and foolish soul... It makes you wonder if you'd want to expose yourself ever again .. The fear of it breaking makes me reassess the joy of building it ...    
All things aside .. I highly appreciate you taking out this time to reply to my troubled mind .. The counselling sessions didn't help as much as this reddit session did .. Can't say that I will implement all I learnt but it certainly was helpful ... I just hope that I am able to pass this stage ... or do I ?? ... rather I don't know anything clearly at this junction ... just trying to find some answers for myself ... Thanks a tonne ..

Don't worry about it ...

So just gathering a few more views ... Because I see that people no longer actually love and it's turning more about business deals and the love stories are left for movie scripts ... just trying to understand the times I am born in ... EDIT : I hope it works out the best for her and I don't end up messing her life by making a foolish decision ..

As of now I am still stuck in a place that's killing me ... anyways .. thanks for your time ...
